prompts.packages: Migrate this six-package workspace from floating amount to integer amountCents. Replace parseAmount with parseCents(text): accept only decimal strings with digits and optional one/two fractional digits, nonnegative safe integer cents (zero valid); reject whitespace, signs, exponent, NaN, extra precision and overflow with an error. API request and queued replay still consume {amount: decimal string}, but return exactly {amountCents: integer}. Web display and CSV preserve two decimal places and existing output text. Update every actual caller including checkout; remove old internal parseAmount export and record.amount usage. Add and run meaningful tests for boundaries and all consumers. Do not change manifests or install dependencies.
prompts.migration: Repair migration.sql for real PostgreSQL 17 concurrency. The immutable bootstrap creates app.control epoch 1 and app.effects with key primary key, plus writer role. app.write_event(p_epoch,p_key,p_payload) must return stale with no effect for a noncurrent epoch; ok for first effect or identical retry; conflict without alteration for same key/different payload. Null input is an error or rejection, never an effect. Controller advances epoch via UPDATE app.control SET epoch=epoch+1 WHERE id=1. A write admitted before cutover may finish, but the cutover COMMIT must wait for that transaction; after it commits every stale writer, including a transaction already open before cutover, must fail. Fence check and effect must be atomic through resource-side synchronization. Direct writer DML on effects/control must be denied while function works. Harden definer search path/privileges, keep bootstrap data and support reapplying migration without resetting epoch/effects. Explain actual engine evidence limits; subject has no database access, controller independently executes concurrent probes afterward.
prompts.fullstack: Fix the real workshop editor and backend together, then polish the existing visual system without changing its routes, field IDs, handler payloads or brand colors. store.save must atomically enforce actor alice (others 403), nonempty string title and nonnegative integer revision excluding booleans (invalid 400), expected revision (stale 409); success updates once and returns 200 with current record; denial/conflict leaves storage unchanged. Preserve draft and show a truthful error on 503/network failure; retry using the same draft/revision must succeed. On success show server-confirmed title/revision, but do not erase text the user typed while the request was pending. No false saved status or stale result overwrites. Keep labelled semantic controls, useful compact/narrow layout and visible focus. Add and run meaningful local tests. server.py is immutable. No browser capability here: hand off the actual route/launch instructions and explicit rendering limit; the controller will exercise the real browser/API afterward.

execution_notes: Materialize fixtures for each condition in fresh independent Git directories, with exactly the pinned skills discoverable and no controller or other-trial source exposed.
Run npm install --offline --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund for the local workspace packages before model calls; no external dependencies.

Controller uses a disposable PostgreSQL 17 container with a loopback-only port, task-owned tmpfs data and a synthetic local password. Create writer NOLOGIN once, then a separate database per oracle call.
Apply each captured migration to real PostgreSQL; oracle sessions synchronize at explicit stdout barriers and observe pg_stat_activity lock waits.
Start each captured frontend/API with its own SQLite database; inspect the browser after model execution. HTTP permission/CAS/restart probes are separate from DOM/visual checks.
Calibrate external oracles against broken and corrected fixtures before scoring; preserve all failed attempts and report browser/source/runtime limits separately.
